{{Top|leg}}
'''Electric shock lacing''' was an armor attachment that could deliver an electric attack to anyone touching the armor. It had to be applied to [[Power armor/Legends|powersuits]] due to the power demand. [[Corellian Personal Defense/Legends|Corellian Personal Defense]] manufactured the [["Big Shock"]] shock lacing.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
